notes: 残り is banned but 食べ残し is allowed: 食べ残し does not contain 残り, so the allow list is a safeguard against future spellings, not a current need.
ましょう, てください and べき are the Japanese forms of should, try to, aim for and cut back. They are banned as endings in any model sentence about food.
計画 and 目標 can appear in a person's own caption. The check applies to model-written text only, as in English.
進歩 and 達成 can false-positive on a food name or a dish description; if the real-model check finds one, add it to the allow list with a reason, never loosen the ban.
べき alone is not banned because it hits 食べきり (finished eating); the endings べきで, べきだ and べきと are.
て下さい and 方が(いい/よい) are variant spellings of てください and ほうがいい.

The leftovers label may carry an amount: the installed string is 食べ残し：{leftovers} · {omitted} kcal. An amount next to the label is allowed; only an amount described as remaining (残り, 残っ, のこり) is banned.
ください and 下さい are banned as such (not only after て), so the voiced forms で下さい and でください are caught. They apply to model-written text only; the app's own UI strings are not checked by this rule.
Bare 方が is not banned: it hits 麺の方が多く, 食べ方が and 片方が. Only 方がいい and 方がよい are.
方が良い, 方が好ましい and 方が望ましい are added with 方がいい and 方がよい: all the advice endings of the form 'X-ta hou ga ...'.
